The PIN can\'t be recovered, because it encrypts the saved passwords and keys of your network locations. FilesCtrl will turn the app lock off and forget those passwords and keys. The locations stay; you\'ll enter their passwords again.
At least %1$d digits, different from your phone\'s PIN. If you forget it, the saved passwords and keys of your network locations are lost (the locations stay).
PINs now need at least %1$d digits, different from your phone\'s PIN. Your saved passwords and keys are encrypted with it while the app is locked.

Ask for an app PIN (and optionally your fingerprint) when opening FilesCtrl. While locked, saved passwords and keys stay encrypted with the PIN, and your servers don\'t show in other apps\' file pickers. Copies and moves that are already running finish.
FilesCtrl has no analytics or tracking. It only connects to the network locations you add.
